duration.text: The Chinese Language at Xiamen University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 7638 USD/per year ￥ 55000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. foreigners, 18 years old or above, in good health 2. graduates of senior high school or above Qualification of being exempt from the first one or two years study: 1. Any holder of HSK 3 can apply to join the second year of the program. 2. Any holder of HSK 6 can apply to join the third year of the program. 3. Students who have achieved 80 credits of required courses verified by OEC are eligible to apply and, with the approval from OEC, join the third year of the program. 4. Students who have passed the third-grade entrance exam can apply to join the third year of the program and are required to pass HSK 6 before graduation. 5. Any holder of HSK 5 can apply to join the third year of the program and is required to pass HSK 6 before graduation.
